answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable opal stake before joining an orchard of verified peers: the stake is slashed if duplicate identities are detected through overlapping behavior and shared credentials, so creating many fake agents multiplies the locked capital at risk. Like water forced through a narrow canyon, Sybil creation becomes expensive and slow, because an attacker must fund every copy and loses the stake on detection, while honest agents recover theirs after clean attestation.
